summary: Stig Wikander worked in Indology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and linguistics. He studied at Uppsala, Copenhagen, Paris, and Berlin, with teachers including Nyberg, Zetterstéen, Charpentier, and Christensen. He held posts at Lund and Uppsala, alongside visiting positions abroad.

Stuart Edward Mann was a linguist and Indologist who graduated in Germanic studies from the University of Bristol. He taught English at Masaryk University from around 1929 to 1939 and taught Czech and Albanian at SSEES from 1947 to 1972.

Stuart H. Blackburn worked in Indology after studying at Wesleyan University and the University of California, Berkeley. He held an academic post at SOAS University of London from around 1993 to 2011.

Stuart Henry Buck was a Tibetologist who earned his A.B. from Harvard University between 1929 and 1933. He later worked as an intelligence analyst at the National Security Agency from around 1953 to 1980.

Stuart Piggott was a scholar in archaeology and Indology who studied at Churcher's College and UCL. He worked at Reading Museum, the University of Oxford, and served as Professor of Archaeology at the University of Edinburgh beginning in 1948.
Stuart Ray Sarbacker works in religious studies, Indology, and philosophy. He completed his Ph.D. at the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 2001 under the supervision of David M. Knipe.

Su Bai worked in archaeology, Buddhist studies, and sinology. He completed graduate studies at Peking University under Feng Chengjun, Sun Zuoyun, Geng Rong, and Tang Yongtong, subsequently serving as a professor at Peking University from 1948 to 2004.

Subhadradis Diskul worked in archaeology, studying at Chulalongkorn University, École du Louvre under Philippe Stern, and UCL. He held posts at the National Museum Bangkok, served as professor, dean, and rector at Silpakorn University, and directed SEAMEO SPAFA.
Subhash Chandra works in computational linguistics and Indology. He earned his Ph.D. from Jawaharlal Nehru University in 2012 and is attested as a professor at the University of Delhi in 2026.

Subhash Kak studied at NIT Srinagar and IIT Delhi under P. V. Indiresan. An Indologist and engineer, he held posts at Louisiana State University, Oklahoma State University, Jawaharlal Nehru University, Imperial College London, Bell Labs, and TIFR.

Subodhkant Mishra works in Indology and religious studies. Educated at Banaras Hindu University, the University of Delhi, and IGNOU, he has held posts at Shree Mahendra Das Degree College, Indus University, and the Central University of Punjab.

Subrata K. Mitra studied at Utkal University, University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Rochester. He held posts at the University of Hull, Heidelberg University, and the National University of Singapore.
Sucharita Adluri works in religious studies and Indology. She completed her Ph.D. at the University of Pennsylvania and has served as a professor at Cleveland State University since 2009.

Sucheng Chan is a historian who completed studies at Swarthmore College, the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, and the University of California, Berkeley. She served as an emerita professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara.
Sudan Shakya works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He is attested as a professor at Shuchiin University from 2013 to 2017 and in 2026.

Sudarshan Chakradhari specializes in archaeology and Indology. He completed his Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University between 2013 and 2019 and became an assistant professor at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University in 2023.

Sudhir Kakar was a scholar of religious studies and Indology educated at Gujarat University, University of Mannheim, University of Vienna, and Sigmund-Freud-Institut. He held posts at Harvard, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Delhi, and visiting roles at INSEAD and Chicago.

Sudhākara Dvivedī was an Indologist who studied under Devakṛṣṇa. He worked as a librarian and professor of mathematics and astrology at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, also serving as head of the mathematics faculty, and taught at Sanskrit College and University.

Sue Hamilton works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. She completed a D.Phil. at Oxford under Richard Gombrich and Alexis Sanderson, later holding posts at King's College London and University College London as Professor of Prehistory.

Suehiro Tanemura studied at the University of Tokyo from around 1953 to 1957. He subsequently held posts at Tokyo Metropolitan University from around 1973 to 1987 and at Kokugakuin University from around 1987 to 2002.
